title: French Potato Stew
description: A hearty and comforting French-inspired potato stew, perfect for a cold evening. Made with tender potatoes and a rich, flavorful broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of irish in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1/4 cup of innovative and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add 2 pounds of potato and cook until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Pour in 4 cups of light and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in 1 can of stew and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
